#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>

using namespace std;

typedef long long LL;

const LL MOD = 1000000007;

LL p, K;

LL fastPow(LL base, LL exp) {
    LL result = 1;
    while (exp > 0) {
        if (exp & 1) result = (result * base) % MOD;
        base = (base * base) % MOD;
        exp >>= 1;
    }
    return result;
}

int main() {
    cin >> p >> K;
    if (K == 0) {
        cout << fastPow(p, p - 1) << "\n";
        return 0;
    } else if (K == 1) {
        cout << fastPow(p, p) << "\n";
        return 0;
    }
    vector<bool> visited(p, false);
    int count_cycles = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < p; ++i) {
        if (visited[i]) continue;
        int size = 0;
        LL tmp = i;
        while (!visited[tmp]) {
            size++;
            visited[tmp] = true;
            tmp = (tmp * K) % p;
        }
        if (size > 1) count_cycles++;
    }
    cout << fastPow(p, count_cycles) << "\n";
    return 0;
}
